runs.notes: file-level green = every executed test in the file passed and the file reported no out-of-test error; all-skipped / no-tests / blocked-external are separate buckets and are NOT passes. The corpus npm dependencies must be installed first (see compat/README.md) -- without them 264 files die at load; test/node_modules is excluded from discovery so third-party packages do not inflate the corpus

runs.binary: r9/integration (round 9 + round 10, assert.throws fixed, permission model)

baseline_for_comparison.binary: round-8 HEAD (23217dd), measured with the SAME corrected runner

runs.notes: A file that skipped itself (common.skip() -> '1..0 # Skipped:', exit 0) is classified `skipped`, never `pass`. common.mustCall is enforced from this binary onward (node registers its verifier in process.on('exit'), which previously never fired). Both corrections lower the number relative to previously published figures; the 44.5% published against round 8 was a product of both defects and was never real. Full estimate-vs-actual and methodology: compat/data/round-estimates.json and compat/README.md. A third verification defect was fixed after the previous entry: assert.throws ignored its error argument, so any throw satisfied any matcher. That removed 126 passes (25 of 25 sampled confirmed vacuous), which is why this figure is LOWER than the previously recorded 47.9%/54.7%.
